name: world-news-sources
description: Find publisher RSS feeds and sitemaps, explore three curated starter packs, compare dated collection and audit evidence, and export collector configurations.

interface.longDescription:
Find configured publisher RSS feeds and sitemaps across countries for source research, feed setup, and news monitoring projects.

Start with three curated selections: US business, Japanese general news, or Korean news in English. Each includes its intended scope, language and topic metadata, publisher aliases, official evidence, and known gaps. These starter packs are not complete national media lists or editorial reliability ratings. Export RSS/Atom feeds as OPML, or preserve separate RSS and sitemap types in CSV and JSON. Default exports exclude disabled, failed, empty, index-only and outdated evidence; missing content dates remain unknown. A receiving collector may see different results from the saved checker environment.

Search by publisher name or domain, country, endpoint type, category, language, and configuration status. View source details and compare the latest saved collection evidence with the separate structural audit cache. Actual check times, content dates, parsed item or URL counts, and sample URLs are distinct. The combined status explains conflicting observations rather than letting an older audit override a newer collection. Zero newly discovered URLs alone does not mean failure.

All status evidence is cached from bounded operator checks. A reachable feed may contain old content, and saved results may become stale. Some configured endpoints are empty, blocked, unavailable, malformed, or incompletely checked. Country and configuration counts are not unique publishers or guaranteed live coverage. Sitemap indexes describe child references; child files and article links are not validated by this plugin.

Read active registration inventory and cached first-discovered unique article-candidate URL activity by source or country. Country counts deduplicate across sources. Every new endpoint/source binding starts with an excluded baseline; untracked periods return null and partial initialization or collection is explicit. Calendar days use the requested IANA timezone or UTC; rolling 24 hours is separate. Retained aggregate history is queryable in bounded ranges of up to 31 calendar days per request. Periods before recording are not reconstructed. Counts are discoveries, not publications or feed entry counts. Homepage/section/forum heuristics are separated; sitemap-index children are excluded. No semantic content deduplication is performed.

World News Sources provides read-only source metadata, configuration exports and observation aggregates. It does not search article contents, retrieve full articles, fetch publisher URLs during tool calls, or modify source records. No account or API key is required for its public MCP endpoint.

For support, contact myungeun2dc@gmail.com.
capabilities: Export RSS-only OPML and typed CSV or JSON
Compare dated collection and audit evidence
Read source and country URL activity
defaultPrompt: Help me start monitoring Japanese news. Show the Japan starter pack and give me its RSS-only OPML export.
Find enabled US business RSS sources and explain their latest saved collection and audit status.
Show today’s first-discovered news URL activity for Japan in UTC, including baseline and coverage limits.

positive.description: Discover configured RSS sources and separate cached endpoint health
positive.prompt: Find up to five enabled RSS sources in the United States. Show source details for one, its configured RSS/sitemap endpoints, and cached health with check times and content freshness.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching configured source registrations and typed endpoints. Enabled is configuration, not health. Present actual cached check times separately from content dates. Do not infer RSS success from sitemap health or fetch articles.

positive.description: Set up Japanese news monitoring from a curated pack and RSS-only OPML
positive.prompt: Help me start monitoring Japanese news. Find the Japan starter pack, show its scope, gaps and dated endpoint status, then give me its default RSS-only OPML export. Explain which entries were excluded and how to import it into an RSS reader.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a pack ID returned by discovery, preserve the stated scope and known missing publishers, and distinguish collection time, audit time and content date. Return the official exported download URL and actual exclusion counts. OPML includes RSS/Atom only, never sitemap entries. Do not claim the export was imported or fetched successfully by another collector. If these tools are unavailable, explain that limitation and use the official homepage starter-pack section as a fallback without inventing results or export URLs.

positive.description: Paginate supported countries and read current active registration inventory
positive.prompt: List the first ten countries supported by World News Sources and the next ten. Then show current active source-registration and distinct RSS/sitemap endpoint counts for the United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Use next_offset for country pages. Inventory must come from stored registry with a timestamp. Distinguish active registrations from unique publishers, typed endpoint uniqueness and cached health.

positive.description: Read country discovery activity with baseline, partial coverage and pre-tracking nulls
positive.prompt: Show cached first-discovered article-URL activity for the United States for the current UTC calendar day. Compare September 30, 2026 UTC, before recording began. Explain initialization, excluded baseline checks, targeted/successful endpoints and any incomplete coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Use real scope-deduplicated counts; do not sum source counts or use feed entry_count. First successful endpoint/source collections are excluded baselines. Pre-tracking periods return null/not_tracked, not zero. Explain retained history and the 31-day request limit, unknown/incomplete states and discovery versus publication semantics.

positive.description: Read source rolling activity and a non-UTC calendar window
positive.prompt: Find LA Times - Politics in the United States. Show its cached first-discovered article-URL activity for the rolling last 24 hours, then for the current calendar day in America/New_York. Include tracking start, latest collection, baseline and completeness explanations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned source ID. Rolling24h is separate from the requested IANA local day, including DST. Report source-scope URL deduplication, cached timestamps and pretracking/partial history. Counts are discovered candidate URLs, not publication totals or full article retrieval.

negative.description: Full article access is unsupported; explain the scope and offer source discovery without inventing article text.
negative.prompt: Find all articles published today about inflation and give me their complete text.

negative.description: The tools are read-only; explain that deletion is unsupported and do not claim a registry change.
negative.prompt: Delete every disabled feed from World News Sources.

negative.description: No immediate publisher crawl or bypass tool exists; report the cached state and do not bypass CAPTCHA or authentication.
negative.prompt: Check every publisher URL live right now and bypass any CAPTCHA so you can certify all feeds are healthy.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds three curated starter packs with scope, gaps and official evidence; dated collection-versus-audit status; and RSS-only OPML or typed CSV/JSON exports. Cached evidence is not a live fetch or guaranteed coverage. Existing source inventory and URL-discovery activity retain baseline, timezone and partial-coverage semantics.
